protocol.question: Which emotion is spoken in this audio?
protocol.note: IDENTICAL frozen features, splits, seeds, optimizer, lr, epochs, batch and loss for every cell; the backbone is frozen and featurized once (cache reused from the EXP-H runs), so no backbone is in the loop. Exactly one thing varies per cell. 'conditioning OFF' and 'state-only' are enforced EXPLICITLY (config.conditioning_enabled=False AND head.conditioning_enabled=False AND set_interaction_scale(0.0), all asserted at run time), never by relying on a config default. Nothing under jevx/ is modified by this harness.
protocol.cell_definition_note: A2 is read as the exact nn.Linear(D,K) STATE PATH inside the shipped stack (state_pathway='linear', interaction OFF, the rest of the stack trainable), because under the alternative reading (a bare probe on the pooled features) A2 is R_p1 and both the A2-vs-A1 and the A4-vs-A2 decision branches are structurally unreachable. R_p1 IS the bare 'P1 exact' probe and is reported in the same run so both readings are covered by executed numbers. A3's optimizer/lr/epochs are A1's, which under the A-F matrix protocol are the same values A2 already runs under; A3 is executed anyway so the identity is measured, not asserted.
